The config file is `config.json` in the gournal home folder. These keys are supported.

| Key | Type | Default | Description |
|-----|------|---------|-------------|
| `deviceId` | string | Generated on first run | Gournal generates this stable id for the machine. Do not change it. **Validation:** A non-empty string. Any other value stops gournal with an error. |
| `weekStartsOn` | integer | 1 | The first day of the week, from 0 (Sunday) to 6. It sets the start of the `--week` option, the MCP `week` period, and the window that links GitHub activity to entries. **Validation:** An integer from 0 to 6. Other values give a warning and the default. |
| `projectAliases` | Record<string, string> | {} | Maps an old project name to the name to use, for example `{ "old-name": "new-name" }`. **Validation:** An object of strings. An alias chain is an error: if `a` maps to `b`, then `b` must not be a key in the same map. |
| `tagAliases` | Record<string, string> | {} | Maps an old tag to the tag to use, for example `{ "bugfix": "bug" }`. **Validation:** An object of strings. An alias chain is an error: if `a` maps to `b`, then `b` must not be a key in the same map. |
| `ticketPrefixes` | string[] | [] | Lists ticket prefixes, for example `["SBDC", "PLAT"]`. A tag that looks like a ticket becomes a Jira ref only when its prefix is in this list. **Validation:** An array of strings. Any other value stops gournal with an error. |
| `staleAfterDays` | integer | 14 | The age in days after which an open blocker or next item counts as stale. **Validation:** A positive integer. Other values give a warning and the default. |
| `github.autoSync` | boolean | true | Turns on auto-sync of GitHub activity. Auto-sync runs only in `standup`, `log`, `get_standup`, and `get_work_log`. **Validation:** true or false. Other values give a warning and the default. |
| `github.autoSyncMinutes` | integer | 15 | The number of minutes that auto-sync waits between syncs. **Validation:** A positive integer. Other values give a warning and the default. |
| `github.initialSyncDays` | integer | 30 | The number of days of GitHub activity that the first sync reads. **Validation:** A positive integer. Other values give a warning and the default. |
| `github.owners.include` | string[] | [] | Limits the sync to these owners (users or organizations). The match ignores case, and `exclude` wins over this list. **Validation:** An array of strings. Other values give a warning and an empty list. |
| `github.owners.exclude` | string[] | [] | Skips these owners (users or organizations) in the sync. The match ignores case, and this list wins over `include`. **Validation:** An array of strings. Other values give a warning and an empty list. |
